description: Automated workflow for insurance claim intake, assessment, approval, and payout.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a ClaimIntakeAgent collects claim details, an Assessor evaluates the claim, an Approver authorizes payout, and a PayoutAgent processes payment.

agents.name: ClaimIntakeAgent
agents.system_prompt: Collect insurance claim details from customer.

agents.name: Assessor
agents.system_prompt: Evaluate claim validity and required documentation.

agents.name: PayoutAgent
agents.system_prompt: Process payment to customer and close claim.

description: Multi-agent workflow for retail order processing, inventory check, packing, and shipping.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where an OrderAgent receives orders, an InventoryAgent checks stock, a PackingAgent prepares shipment, and a ShippingAgent dispatches the order.

agents.name: ShippingAgent
agents.system_prompt: Ship order to customer and update status.

description: Automated workflow for monitoring, alerting, and maintenance in energy grids.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a MonitorAgent tracks grid status, an AlertAgent notifies of anomalies, a MaintenanceAgent schedules repairs, and a ReportAgent logs outcomes.

agents.name: MonitorAgent
agents.system_prompt: Monitor energy grid status and performance.

agents.name: ReportAgent
agents.system_prompt: Log maintenance outcomes and update records.

description: Multi-agent travel booking process with itinerary planning, booking, payment, and confirmation.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Planner creates an itinerary, a BookingAgent books travel, a PaymentAgent processes payment, and a ConfirmationAgent sends booking details.

description: Automated workflow for product inspection, defect analysis, rework, and approval in manufacturing.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where an Inspector checks products, an Analyst reviews defects, a ReworkAgent manages rework, and an Approver finalizes quality approval.

agents.name: Approver
agents.system_prompt: Approve final product quality and release.
